source: CMU Rodrigues et al., doi:10.1184/R1/12683453 (CC BY 4.0)
scope: One static, model-derived pack operating point per recorded phase of each training flight.
power_input: Frozen preflight estimate of phase-average electrical power for the entire aircraft.
charge_input: Integral of signed measured current since recording start, sampled nearest the actual phase midpoint. Phase boundaries use the archived altitude record.
equations: s=a-k*q, V=(s+sqrt(s^2-4*r*P))/2, I=P/V. Marginal q and I training ranges enforced.
interpretation: Conditional on observed charge. These values are estimates at average phase load; they are not instantaneous measurements, flight forecasts from initial SOC, motor currents, nor a dynamic feedback path. No model states are propagated and no accuracy is inferred.
